source_name: Media Ownership Monitor Kosovo - Serbian-language outlet registry
why_relevant: Systematic registry of Kosovo media outlets with ownership, reach and language - the fastest way to enumerate ALL Serbian-language outlets in Kosovo (not just the well-known ones) and to judge their independence/credibility before adding them to a monitoring list.

source_name: kos-info.net - agregator srpskih izvora sa Kosova
why_relevant: News aggregator that indexes Serbian-language Kosovo outlets by source (izvor), giving a single crawl point covering many small enclave outlets at once and revealing which outlets exist. Efficient discovery and low-cost broad monitoring layer.

source_name: Kosovo Online (srpski informativni portal)
why_relevant: High-volume Serbian-language Kosovo news portal; observed reporting specifically on Procurement Review Body (Telo za razmatranje javnih nabavki) decisions challenging the legality of procurement processes - i.e. it actively covers the tender/award beat in Serbian. Domain inferred from the outlet's official Facebook presence rather than fetched, so treat the exact URL as unverified.

source_name: Uprava za javne nabavke (JJN/KRPP) - Serbian pages of the Office of the Prime Minister site
why_relevant: Institutional/regulatory layer of Kosovo procurement presented in Serbian: rules, standard forms, annual procurement reports and terminology. Provides the authoritative Serbian-language vocabulary (ugovorni organ, ekonomski operater, obavestenje o ugovoru) needed to build reliable sr-language queries against the notice corpus.

source_name: Kosovo public procurement law, Serbian-language text (Kuvendi archive)
why_relevant: Serbian-language statutory text establishing publication duties, thresholds and notice types. Foundational for knowing WHICH documents must exist for a given contract value and therefore what to look for and when a source is incomplete. Also a controlled vocabulary source. (Older law version - the current consolidated law should be sourced from e-prokurimi legislation section.)

source_name: eKosova - state e-services portal (Serbian language option)
why_relevant: Kosovo's central e-government platform, offered in Albanian, English and Serbian. Relevant as the delivery channel for citizen/business payments to the state (fees, taxes, municipal charges) - i.e. the public-sector payment rails whose vendors and payment-service integrations are the ultimate subject of many payment-services contracts.

source_name: EPS Elektrokosmet / EPS javne nabavke (Serbia-run utility operating in Serb-majority Kosovo areas)
why_relevant: Elektrokosmet is the Serbia-side electricity operator serving Serb-majority areas; utility billing and cash-collection are among the largest recurring payment-services contracts in this sphere (collection points, cash handling, billing systems). Its procurement is published in Serbian on the EPS procurement pages, entirely outside Kosovo portals.

source_name: Poreska uprava Kosova (PAK/ATK) - Serbian-language notices and award documents
why_relevant: Tax administration publishes its own contract award notices in Serbian (a Serbian-language 'OBAVESTENJE O DODELI UGOVORA' PDF was found on its media desk) and is a significant buyer of payment-collection, card-acceptance and banking services for tax payments. Also confirms that central institutions do publish Serbian-language award notices on their own domains, not only on e-prokurimi.

source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (Central Bank of Kosovo register of licensed financial institutions)
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every licensed bank, microfinance institution, non-bank financial institution (incl. payment/e-money type IFJB), insurer, exchange office and pension fund in Kosovo. This is the master buyer-universe list for A2 tender monitoring: you cannot scan for banking/payments tenders without first naming the licensed institutions.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (dated PDF snapshot)
why_relevant: The machine-collectable artefact behind the register: a dated PDF with full legal names, addresses and contact details of each licensed institution. Ideal seed file for an entity table (aliases, legal suffixes SH.A./J.S.C.) used to match tender award notices.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës / Kosovo Banking Association (KBA)
why_relevant: Sector association founded 2002; its member list is the standard shorthand enumeration of commercial banks in Kosovo, and the association also publishes sector positions and events that reveal joint infrastructure projects (cards, instant payments) preceding tenders.

source_name: FSDK — Fondi i Sigurimit të Depozitave në Kosovë, Bankat Anëtare
why_relevant: Statutory deposit-insurance membership is compulsory for licensed banks, so this list is an independent cross-check on the BQK bank universe and updates when a bank enters/exits. FSDK itself is also a small contracting authority (IT/DRC projects).

source_name: ARBK — Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës (official business registry)
why_relevant: Sole institution for business registration in Kosovo; the authoritative source of legal names, unique business numbers, legal form, owners/authorised representatives and activity codes for both contracting-authority-adjacent public enterprises and candidate suppliers. Needed to resolve tender bidder names to real entities.

source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — open mirror of the Kosovo business registry
why_relevant: Third-party open mirror allowing search over registrations, owners, activities and statistics from the ARBK public registry — far more collectable than the official ASP.NET forms, and useful for bulk supplier/ownership enrichment behind tender award analysis.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo — Open Businesses (scraped ARBK dataset, 170k+ businesses)
why_relevant: Civic-tech dataset explicitly built to link business registration data with public procurement and asset declarations — exactly the join needed to go from an award notice to a company profile and its owners.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Kosovo Business Registration Agency jurisdiction page
why_relevant: Normalised, queryable copy of Kosovo company records with stable identifiers; useful for cross-border ownership tracing of bidders (Turkish, Slovenian, Austrian, Albanian parents are common in XK banking/IT).

source_name: OCCRP Aleph — Kosovo Business Registration Agency dataset
why_relevant: Investigative-grade indexed copy of ARBK data, searchable by person as well as company — helps expose beneficial owners and directors linking suppliers to bank/public-sector counterparts.

source_name: STIKK — Shoqata e TIK e Kosovës, member directory
why_relevant: The ICT association member directory is the candidate-supplier universe for banking/payments IT tenders: system integrators and distributors that actually bid (CACTTUS, Kosbit, ITD Prishtinë, StarLabs, Ericsson Nikola Tesla branch, BIT Kosova, Panamic ICT). Each member page carries capabilities and vendor authorisations useful for competitor mapping.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (OEK) — Kosovo Chamber of Commerce
why_relevant: Statutory chamber founded 1962 (Law No. 2004/7) with sectoral departments; its membership and sector-council composition enumerate mid-size Kosovar firms including IT and services suppliers, and its export/investment department publishes company listings.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — Membership Directory
why_relevant: Well-structured, browsable directory (alphabetical and by category, incl. Patron Members) that reliably enumerates banks, payment/fintech firms and IT vendors active in Kosovo — one of the cleanest scrapable actor lists in the market.

source_name: OEGJK / KDWV — Oda Ekonomike Gjermano-Kosovare, Lista e plotë e anëtarëve
why_relevant: German-Kosovar chamber with ~200 members and an explicitly published full member list (including a downloadable member-company document) — a compact enumeration of firms with EU vendor ties, likely bidders/partners on banking IT projects.

source_name: AMIK — Shoqata e Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare të Kosovës, Anëtarët e AMIK
why_relevant: Enumerates the microfinance/NBFI segment (KEP Trust, KRK, AFK, Kos Invest and others) — a second tier of financial buyers that procure core banking, lending and payment systems and are easily missed if only banks are tracked.

source_name: BKS — Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit / Shoqata e Sigurimeve të Kosovës
why_relevant: Insurance bureau/association covering ~14 insurers (12 non-life, 2 life) with mixed domestic/Austrian/Albanian/Slovenian capital. Insurers are adjacent buyers of payment, claims and IT systems, and BKS itself runs sector infrastructure that gets tendered.
